name: MerkleClaimBudget
description: Budget. Pays cumulative Merkle allocations: each account claims what it is owed and may name another beneficiary, and the flow's root receives exactly that amount. The trigger's budget data is abi.encode(account, cumulative, proof, beneficiary). Records claims through the DAO, so it needs RECORD_CLAIM_PERMISSION_ID for the DAO.

inputs.name: dao
inputs.description: The installing DAO. In a recipe: DAO_REF.

inputs.name: token
inputs.description: The token the claims are paid in.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Merkle root of (account, cumulative amount) leaves, OpenZeppelin StandardMerkleTree format.
